# Summary

This is data from: "Citizen-science and empirical field data yield limited agreement about avian diversity" by Zou et al.

Archived by Yi Zou (yi.zou@xjtlu.edu.cn; yi.zou.1@hotmail.com)

# Description

The dataset contains 4 documents:

1.  "CSdata5km.csv" is the citizen-science bird data derived from the China Bird Reporting Center (www.birdreport.cn)

2.  "EMdata.csv" is the empirical survey data in 10 nature reserves.

3.  "Analysis.R" is the R code for the main analysis, generating the Figure 2 and Figure 3.

4.  "Appendix1.R" is the R code for the appendix analysis, generating the Appendix figure.
